dataset_name: Women Startup & Entrepreneurship Schemes in India
description: Comprehensive dataset of government schemes supporting women entrepreneurs and women-led startups across India
source_note: Compiled from official government sources including PIB press releases, Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha questions, and ministry publications

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Female students from Higher Educational Institutions
schemes.tags: Women; Entrepreneurship; Training; Mentorship; EDP; EAP; NITI Aayog
schemes.brief_description: A structured multi-stage training program to help young women transition from ideation to successful enterprise creation, covering entrepreneurial awareness, intensive development training, and 21 weeks of mentorship.
schemes.benefits: Entrepreneurship Awareness Programme (EAP) for 1200 students; Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) for 600 selected students; 21 weeks of mentorship and handholding; Faculty Development Programme (FDP) for 75 faculty members; Seed funding facilitation by NITI Aayog
schemes.eligibility: Female students from Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs) and Universities in pilot states (Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Uttar Pradesh, Telangana)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Women; SC/ST; Entrepreneur; Loan; Greenfield; Stand-Up India
schemes.brief_description: Provides loans from Scheduled Commercial Banks between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Composite loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore; Covers 85% of project cost; Repayment period up to 7 years; Maximum moratorium up to 18 months; Interest rate not exceeding base rate MCLR+3%+Tenor premium
schemes.eligibility: SC/ST or Women entrepreneurs; Age above 18 years; For greenfield projects in manufacturing, services, trading sector, or activities allied to agriculture; Only first-time entrepreneurs
schemes.application_mode: Online via www.standupmitra.in or through bank branches

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.sub_categories: Credit Linked Subsidy; Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship
schemes.tags: Subsidy; Loan; Entrepreneur; Women; Rural; Urban; PMEGP
schemes.brief_description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up micro enterprises. Women entrepreneurs receive higher subsidy rates compared to non-special category.
schemes.benefits: Subsidy up to 35% for women in rural areas and 25% in urban areas; Maximum project cost ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service sector; 39.26% of total entrepreneurs benefitted in 2024-25 were women
schemes.eligibility: Age above 18 years; Minimum 8th standard pass for projects above ₹10 lakh; Only new units eligible; Women are classified as Special Category

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.department: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
schemes.tags: Women; Entrepreneur; Loan; MSME; Startup; SIDBI; Soft Loan
schemes.brief_description: Soft loan scheme for women entrepreneurs to set up new small-scale industries or expand existing ones with concessional interest rates.
schemes.benefits: Total project cost up to ₹10 lakh; Soft loan capped at 25% of project cost with maximum ₹2.5 lakh; Repayment tenure up to 10 years including moratorium up to 5 years; No collateral or security deposit required
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs; New or existing small-scale industries; Manufacturing, production, service, modernization, diversification, or technology upgradation activities
schemes.application_mode: Through SIDBI or participating public sector banks and regional rural banks

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.sub_categories: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship; Training and Skill Up-gradation
schemes.tags: Coir; Women; Entrepreneur; Training; Self-employment; Mahila Coir
schemes.brief_description: First women-oriented self-employment scheme implemented by the Coir Board for empowerment of rural women artisans in the coir industry through training and equipment support.
schemes.benefits: Training in coir processing; Motorized ratts and equipment provided with 75% subsidy; Stipend during training; More than 80% of workforce in coir industry are women
schemes.eligibility: Rural women artisans; Age 18 years and above; Residents of coir-producing states

schemes.scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.tags: SC; Women; Venture Capital; Entrepreneurship; Concessional Finance
schemes.brief_description: Provides concessional finance to SC women entrepreneurs at a reduced interest rate to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste women.
schemes.benefits: Concessional interest rate of 3.75% for SC women; Provides equity funding and hand-holding support
schemes.eligibility: SC women entrepreneurs; Annual family income up to ₹3 lakh

schemes.scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.tags: SC; Women; Innovation; Incubation; Startup; Technology
schemes.brief_description: Supports young SC women innovators with financial assistance up to ₹30 lakh to translate innovative technology-oriented business ideas into commercial enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹30 lakh; Access to Technology Business Incubators; Mentorship and hand-holding support
schemes.eligibility: SC women innovators and students; Must be identified by Technology Business Incubators

schemes.scheme_name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) Loans
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.sub_categories: Loan; Micro finance; Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship
schemes.tags: SC; Women; Loan; Microfinance; Self-employment
schemes.brief_description: Provides concessional loans to eligible SC persons including women with annual family income up to ₹3 lakh, through term loans and microfinance loans.
schemes.benefits: Term loans up to ₹45 lakh; Microfinance loans up to ₹1.25 lakh; 40% coverage of women beneficiaries mandated; Market linkages under Public Procurement Policy (3% procurement for women-owned MSEs)
schemes.eligibility: SC persons; Annual family income up to ₹3 lakh

schemes.scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Tribes (VCF-ST)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
schemes.tags: ST; Women; Venture Capital; Entrepreneurship; Concessional Finance
schemes.brief_description: Offers concessional finance between ₹10 lakh and ₹5 crore at 4% interest, with an additional 0.25% concession for ST women entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefits: Concessional finance between ₹10 lakh and ₹5 crore; Interest rate 4% with additional 0.25% concession for ST women (effective 3.75%); Incubation support up to ₹30 lakh; At least 30% beneficiaries should preferably be women
schemes.eligibility: ST entrepreneurs including women; Launched February 2025

schemes.scheme_name: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
schemes.tags: ST; Women; Loan; SHG; Self-employment
schemes.brief_description: Provides concessional loans through various schemes for economic development of Scheduled Tribes across the country, including women.
schemes.benefits: Concessional loans for self-employment and income-generating activities
schemes.eligibility: ST individuals, SHGs, and cooperative societies; Annual family income limit of ₹3 lakh

schemes.scheme_name: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFC) - Women Loan
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
schemes.tags: Minority; Women; Loan; Microfinance; Concessional
schemes.brief_description: Provides concessional credit for self-employment and income-generating activities of minority women with special interest concessions.
schemes.benefits: Term Loan at 6% p.a. for women (vs 8% for men); Micro Finance at 8% p.a. for women (vs 10% for men); Education Loan at 5% p.a. for women (vs 8% for men); Virasat Scheme for artisans: additional 1% concession for women; 98-99% beneficiaries under Micro Finance Scheme are women
schemes.eligibility: Minority women; Organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs); Loans up to ₹1 lakh (Credit Line-1) or ₹1.5 lakh (Credit Line-2)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Women; Entrepreneur; Loan; SBI; Concessional; Stree Shakti
schemes.brief_description: SBI's flagship scheme for women entrepreneurs providing financial support across manufacturing, trading, and service sectors with interest rate concessions.
schemes.benefits: Loans up to ₹25 crore; Interest rate concession up to 0.50% on loans up to ₹2 crore; Credit guarantee support through CGTMSE; Collateral may be waived for some loans up to ₹1 crore; Repayment period 7-10 years for term loans
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs; Business in manufacturing, trading, or services; Majority ownership by women
schemes.application_mode: Through SBI website or branch visit

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.tags: Women; Food; Catering; Restaurant; Tiffin; Loan
schemes.brief_description: Special loan scheme for women entrepreneurs in food-related businesses such as catering, restaurants, tiffin services, and food product ventures.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for new or existing food businesses; Accessible terms under Stree Shakti initiative
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in food-related businesses

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.tags: Women; Beauty Parlour; Salon; Wellness; Loan
schemes.brief_description: Special loan scheme for women entrepreneurs in beauty parlour, salon, and wellness sector businesses.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for business expansion, purchase of beauty equipment, and infrastructure improvement
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in beauty and wellness sector

schemes.ministry: NITI Aayog
schemes.tags: Women; Entrepreneur; Startup; Mentorship; Funding; Networking; WEP
schemes.brief_description: A unified portal providing comprehensive support to women entrepreneurs including funding opportunities, mentorship, and networking through the Award to Reward framework.
schemes.benefits: Access to funding opportunities; Mentorship programs; Incubation support; Networking events; Capacity building workshops; Yashasvini programme for established women entrepreneurs; Swavalambini for aspiring college students
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs; Aspiring women entrepreneurs; Women-led startups

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Startup; Women; Venture Capital; Funding; FFS; SIDBI
schemes.brief_description: Catalyzes venture capital investments by providing capital to SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds which invest in startups including women-led ventures.
schemes.benefits: Supported AIFs have invested around ₹2,838.9 crore in 154 women-led startups (as of Oct 31, 2025)
schemes.eligibility: Startups including women-led ventures through SEBI-registered AIFs

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
schemes.tags: Startup; Women; Seed Fund; Funding; SISFS
schemes.brief_description: Provides financial assistance to seed stage startups through incubators for proof of concept, product development, and market entry.
schemes.benefits: Supported incubators have approved funds of around ₹284.79 crore to 1,635 women-led startups (as of Oct 31, 2025)
schemes.eligibility: Seed stage startups including women-led ventures

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Startup; Women; Credit Guarantee; Collateral-free; CGSS
schemes.brief_description: Enables collateral-free loans to startups through eligible financial institutions with credit guarantee coverage.
schemes.benefits: 24 loans amounting to around ₹33.17 crore guaranteed to women-led startup borrowers (as of Oct 31, 2025)
schemes.eligibility: Startups including women-led ventures

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Mudra; Loan; Women; Micro enterprise; Collateral-free
schemes.brief_description: Provides collateral-free credit up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. About 68% of loans have been granted to women entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free credit up to ₹10 lakh; Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001-₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5-10 lakh), Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh for repeat borrowers); 68% of loans granted to women entrepreneurs; ₹34.11 lakh crore sanctioned to 52.5 crore loan accounts (up to March 2025)
schemes.eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises; Women entrepreneurs prioritized
schemes.application_mode: Through Member Lending Institutions (Banks, NBFCs, MFIs)

schemes.scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Micro and Small Enterprises including Women-owned
schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
schemes.tags: Women; MSE; Credit Guarantee; Collateral-free; CGTMSE
schemes.brief_description: Provides guarantee cover for collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises, with specific concessions for women entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefits: Guarantee cover for collateral-free credit; Ceiling now at ₹10 crore; Specific concessions for women-owned MSEs; Reduces need for collateral
schemes.eligibility: Micro and Small Enterprises including women-owned businesses

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.tags: Udyam; MSME; Registration; Women; Formalization
schemes.brief_description: Official registration portal providing MSME identity through a simple, paperless, self-declaration-based, and free-of-cost online registration process.
schemes.benefits: Access to Government schemes; Easier access to institutional credit; Protection against delayed payments; Participation in public procurement; Access to quality and technology support; Market promotion opportunities
schemes.eligibility: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Aadhaar number sufficient for registration; PAN & GST linked details taken automatically

schemes.tags: Karnataka; Women; Loan; Collateral-free; Udyogini
schemes.brief_description: State-level scheme providing loans up to ₹3 lakh with collateral-free terms for the general category, with subsidy support and income caps.
schemes.benefits: Loans up to ₹3 lakh; Collateral-free for general category; Subsidy support; Annual family income cap around ₹1.5 lakh for general category
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in Karnataka; Family income within prescribed limits

schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance

schemes.eligibility: Women-run units in Karnataka

schemes.tags: Karnataka; Women; Micro-credit; Samrudhi
schemes.brief_description: Micro-credit support for small women-led ventures, routed through the state's development corporations.
schemes.benefits: Micro-credit support; Terms confirmed at district office
schemes.eligibility: Women-led small ventures in Karnataka

schemes.department: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.tags: Ambedkar; AABCS; Scheduled Caste; Scheduled Tribe; Entrepreneur; Loan; Subsidy; MSME; Women
schemes.brief_description: The scheme provides 35% capital subsidy and 6% interest subvention for loans to SC/ST entrepreneurs including women.
schemes.benefits: 35% capital subsidy on Eligible Project Cost up to ₹1.5 Crore; 6% interest subvention for loans up to 10 years; Working capital eligible for interest subvention for 2 years
schemes.eligibility: SC/ST community; 100% owned by SC/ST persons; Age limit 55 years; New enterprises or expansion; Manufacturing and services sectors

schemes.tags: Handicraft; Artisan; ASHA; Financial Assistance; Enterprise; Entrepreneur; Women
schemes.brief_description: Financial assistance in the form of grant to artisans in the handicrafts sector for setting up handicraft enterprises.
schemes.benefits: 40% of Fixed Capital Investment limited to ₹2.00 lakh for General Category; 50% limited to ₹3.00 lakh for Young (18-45 years) Women and SC/ST artisans
schemes.eligibility: Micro Enterprises engaged in handicraft sector; Filed Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part-II or Udyog Aadhaar

schemes.categories: Business & Entrepreneurship; Skills & Employment; Social welfare & Empowerment
schemes.tags: Scheduled Caste; Scheduled Tribe; Female; Other Backward Class; Person With Disability; VJNT; Women
schemes.brief_description: Government of Maharashtra credit linked subsidy program for generation of employment opportunities through establishment of Micro & Small Enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Maximum project cost ₹50 lakh for manufacturing; ₹20 lakh for service sector; Beneficiary contribution 5-10%; Subsidy 15-35% based on category and area
schemes.eligibility: Age 18-45 years (relaxed by 5 years for special category including women); Minimum 7th standard pass for projects above ₹10 lakh; 10th standard for projects above ₹25 lakh

schemes.department: Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department
schemes.tags: Green Taxi; Vehicle; EMI; Subsidy; Electric Vehicle EV; Women
schemes.brief_description: Promotes clean mobility and electric vehicle adoption while supporting green entrepreneurship through financial incentives.
schemes.benefits: 50% of on-road vehicle cost supported; 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months; Total maximum subsidy capped at ₹5,00,000 per vehicle
schemes.eligibility: Age 18-58 years; Valid driving license; Resident of Greater Shillong Planning Area; Not a credit defaulter

schemes.scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission

schemes.tags: Loan; Skill; Employment; SHG; Women

schemes.benefits: Access to range of financial services; Livelihoods collectives; Capacity building; Training; Credit linkages
schemes.eligibility: SHGs in active existence for at least 6 months; Practicing Panchasutras; Qualified as per NABARD grading norms; Women SHGs prioritized
